metadata.title: Maaya Stationery — More in your bag. Less on your bill.
metadata.description: School lists, office restocks and everyday stationery, with wholesale-to-retail value and fewer middlemen.

hero.eyebrow: YOUR EVERYDAY STATIONERY. A BETTER WAY TO BUY.
hero.title: More in your bag.
hero.text: A new school term. A desk that needs restocking. An idea waiting for paper. Get the supplies you need with wholesale-to-retail value, minus the extra layers of markup.
hero.note: For school, work and everything you’re making.

range.title: Little things. Big days.
range.text: The pen you reach for. The notebook you fill. The supplies that keep your day moving. Start here, then bring us your list.

items.title: Put it on paper.
items.label: WRITE & HIGHLIGHT
items.text: Pens, pencils, markers and highlighters. For quick notes, neat homework and ideas worth keeping.

items.title: Turn a fresh page.
items.label: PAPER & NOTEBOOKS
items.text: Notebooks, writing pads and paper. From the first page of term to the last item on your to-do list.

items.title: Keep it together.
items.label: FILE & ORGANISE
items.text: Files, folders, clips and desk essentials. A little order for whatever your day throws at you.

items.title: Make a little mess.
items.label: ART & CRAFT
items.text: Colours, craft basics and creative tools. For school projects, weekend making and the joy of trying.

value.title:
Fewer markups.
Better prices.
value.text: Extra resales mean extra margins. We buy through wholesale channels and sell straight to you, cutting out the multiple retailer layers that can build up the final price.

steps.title: Buy at wholesale
steps.text: We source through wholesale channels, keeping the starting cost lower.

steps.title: Skip extra resales
steps.text: Stock comes to Maaya instead of passing through multiple retailer layers, each adding its own margin.

steps.title: Sell directly to you
steps.text: Fewer accumulated markups mean better everyday prices. Ask us for the current price of your list.

value.caption: We keep the wholesale source. We cut the extra retailer layers.

comparison.title: Where the extra cost comes from
comparison.usualNote: Each extra resale can add handling costs and a profit margin. Those markups build into the final price.
comparison.directNote: Wholesale buying, straight to our customers. Fewer resale margins help us keep everyday stationery cheaper.
comparison.removedNote: These are the extra resales we cut out.
comparison.note: A simple illustration of the model. Actual savings vary by product, brand, pack size and current stock.
